title: Force kill all instances of a process
summary: Use killall with the SIGKILL signal to immediately terminate all instances of a process that is not responding to normal termination requests.

steps.explain: Send the SIGKILL signal to all processes matching the exact name. This forces immediate termination without allowing the process to clean up.

placeholders.name: PROCESS_NAME
placeholders.description: The exact name of the process to force kill.

warnings: Force killing processes can lead to data loss or corrupted files if the application was in the middle of saving.
Use this only if the application is completely unresponsive.

rollback.explain: There is no direct rollback for a force kill. You must restart the application manually if needed.
